concept: Golf townhouses; floor-plan explorer and payment plan.
palette: fairway green, white, oak, sky blue

shots.title: Hero
shots.section: Home hero, full screen behind the headline
shots.camera: Eye-level three-quarter view, 24mm tilt-shift, corrected verticals
shots.prompt: Architectural photograph of a crescent of contemporary townhouses facing a golf course in Dubai Hills. Golden-hour sun rakes across the facade, verticals perfectly straight, landscaped foreground, clear sky with open space above for a headline. It must feel built and lived-in, not rendered. No people. Overall look: bright residential photography, 35mm; colour palette of fairway green, white, oak, sky blue. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.

shots.title: Interiors
shots.camera: Interior, 24mm, eye level, one window light
shots.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four separate photographs separated by thin white gutters, all four in one consistent style and light. Interior photographs inside a crescent of contemporary townhouses facing a golf course, finished in oak, white walls and light, staged and uncluttered, one soft daylight, nobody present. Top-left: the main living room with its view. Top-right: the kitchen and dining area. Bottom-left: the principal bedroom. Bottom-right: the principal bathroom. Overall look: bright residential photography, 35mm; colour palette of fairway green, white, oak, sky blue. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
